name: Taxi Shortcuts
description: Marks taxi paths that have express/shortcut variants: when a shortcut applies, only the first Takeoff and last Landing waypoints of the path are flown and the middle part is skipped. Loaded by ObjectMgr::LoadTaxiShortcuts.

fields.name: Takeoff Length
fields.help: Number of waypoints flown at the start of the path.

fields.name: Landing Length
fields.help: Number of waypoints flown at the end of the path.

fields.name: Comments
fields.help: Informational comment only, not read by the core.
